summary: News Corp filed an 8-K reporting routine disclosures under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, providing daily buyback information to the Australian Securities Exchange as required by ASX rules. The filing does not announce a new tender offer, going-private transaction, or special capital return event; it merely updates on ongoing open-market repurchases. No specific terms—price per share, premium, or closing date—are stated. The filing is an ordinary current report, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. What to watch: routine continuation of the buyback program; no risk-arb angle.
